intent: Perform source-backed process and quality checks: neither attractive plant picture establishes an unseen pot-bottom hole; stage order, negative soil instruction, actual missed spot and concurrent roles require precise reading.
picturePurpose: Purposeful reuse of inspected original plant-setups art: both cropped pot bottoms remain unseen, so both claims that a picture proves the required hole are unsupported. Source cards lead to evidence insufficient, not hole absent. Mature-plant art is a separate check exercise, not a seed-planting outcome. Exact instructions and stages stay in code.

items.material:
Teacher: Before planting, check that each pot has a hole in the bottom.

Original picture-check exercise, separate from the planting demonstration:
Picture A shows a grown plant in a blue pot on a coral cloth.
Picture B shows a grown plant in a blue pot on a closed blue notebook.
Neither picture shows the bottom of its pot.
These grown plants are not a record of the seed-planting task. Leaf colour and the support under a pot do not reveal a bottom hole.
A learner makes two claims to test:
Picture A proves that its pot has a hole in the bottom.
Picture B proves that its pot has a hole in the bottom.
Do not accept either claim just because the plant looks green.

options.text: Picture A proves that its pot has a hole in the bottom.
options.reason: A图有绿叶和布，但没显示盆底；不能据此确认孔存在，也不能反过来断言没有孔。

options.text: Neither picture shows the bottom of its pot.
options.reason: 两图都不显示盆底，说明当前图片证据不足。

options.text: Picture B proves that its pot has a hole in the bottom.
options.reason: B图有绿叶和笔记本，也没有露出盆底；承托物不证明孔存在。

options.text: Teacher: Before planting, check that each pot has a hole in the bottom.
options.reason: 原指令要求直接检查盆底的孔，不能用叶色替代这个检查。

sourceArt.alt: 另编看图检查题复用原创插图：两株绿色植物放在蓝盆中，左盆下是珊瑚色布，右盆下是蓝色笔记本；两张图都没有显示盆底，不能据此确认排水孔。这不是种子刚种下的实际记录。

items.label: 四个阶段里不能漏掉种子
items.prompt: Arrange the four main stages as this instruction gives them.
items.answer: Check pot holes → add soil → put in seed, cover lightly and water → label the date.
items.reason: 先查孔再加土；第三张完整卡先放种子、再轻盖与浇水；最后写日期。本题把加土时不要压太紧作为该阶段的注意事项，不用它替代add soil。
items.hint: 先查每个盆底孔，再add soil；第三张保留After putting in the seed的完整句，最后写日期。

transfer.stem: Which plan keeps the tag check, the two people’s roles and the timing?
transfer.passage:
NEW TRANSCRIPT PRACTICE — AUDIO PENDING
Rui: All the sports shirts are in this box. Can we return them now?
Nia: Check the name tags first. Two are loose.
Rui: I will reattach those tags.
Nia: I will count the shirts while you do that. Then we can return the whole set.
This is a plan after a check, not a report that all the work is finished. Read it as preparation; it is not a listening score.

options.text: Rui reattaches the two tags while Nia counts the shirts; afterwards they return the set.
They check the tags, but Rui counts the shirts while Nia reattaches the two tags before returning the set.
Rui reattaches the tags and Nia counts, but they return the set before those jobs are finished.

answer.display: Rui reattaches the two tags while Nia counts the shirts; afterwards they return the set.

explanation.strategy: 先分清放齐与质量合格，再按说话人找I和you，最后用while与Then核对同时和之后。

steps.text: 装进同一个箱子不等于标签都牢固；检查明确发现两处松动，Rui要重新固定好这些标签。
steps.reason: Two are loose给实际发现，those tags承接这两处；不是还没检查就直接归还。

steps.text: Nia说I will count，you do that指Rui固定标签；while同时进行，Then之后才归还。
steps.reason: 人物不能交换，也不能把归还提到两个收尾任务之前；原文没有报告这些收尾任务已经完成。

distractors.reason: 先检查和归还前做完方向正确，却把Rui固定标签、Nia清点的明确分工交换了。
两人做什么对，却把Then归还提前到收尾完成前，破坏明确的时间关系。

explanation.pitfall: 放齐、做过不等于检查合格；while不是then，动作对了还要同时核对人和先后。

visual.title: 发现问题 → 同时收尾 → 之后归还
